summary.result: The largest reduction was ‘low carbon car collaboration fund’ scenario, and there after were ‘fuel efficiency improving scenario’, and ‘improving driving behavior’ scenario.
summary.background: The contents of analysis were forecast of energy demand by scenario and application as well as reduction of greenhouse gas emission volume, and the period taken for analysis was every 1 year during 2015∼2030.BR Baseline scenario, greenhouse gas emission volume in 2015 would be 7,935,697 M/T and 13,081,986 M/T in 2030, increased 64.8%.
summary.method: The analysis result was average annual increase rate of 3.4%.

summary_ko.background: 분석 내용은 시나리오별 에너지 수요 예측 및 적용뿐만 아니라 온실 가스 배출량 감소에 대한 것이었으며, 분석 기간은 2015~2030년까지 매년 1년씩 진행하였다. 기준 시나리오에 따르면 2015년 온실 가스 배출량은 7,935,697 M/T이고 2030년에는 13,081,986 M/T로 64.8% 증가할 것으로 예측된다.
